notes.title: June 11, 2024 Update Release Notes
notes.notes:
Greetings,

We have an update for The Legend of Legacy HD Remastered. This update has addressed the following issues.
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the final boss form was not reverted after retrying.
[*]Fixed an issue with experience gain referring to the wrong reference instead of the enemy leader.
[*]Fixed an issue where equipment stats were not being reflected until reloading a save[/list]
We hope you enjoy these fixes.

Regards,
NISA

notes.title: March 29, 2024 Update Release Notes
notes.notes:
Greetings,

We have an update for The Legend of Legacy HD Remastered. This update has addressed the following issues.
[list]
[*]Fix potential title screen and music player bugs when "Settings when Inactive" option is set to "Pause".
[*]Fix various music player playback issues.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy these fixes.

Regards,
NISA
